info.bio: British producer Martin Jenkins is also known as Pye Corner Audio Transcription Services, mixing the Radiophonic/library music sound, sometimes with a bit of post-punk.  Jenkins refers to himself as the mysterious and nameless Head Technician in most of his online profiles.  Extra detail is taken to make the audio and visual elements look and sound worn and vintage.  Many songs titles and art refere to analogue recording mediums and hardware. PCA

podcast.title: Contributor to Ghost Box Mythology
podcast.body: Pye Corner Audio is identified as one of the artists who helped establish the aesthetic and sonic mythology of Ghost Box Records. The label focused on themes of failed futures by creating a fictional sound archive based on library music, public service jingles, educational documentaries, and past television iconography, particularly drawing inspiration from the BBC Radiophonic Workshop. "PaiCorneraudio [...] sacaron del armario ese sentir de futuro fallido y lo convirtieron en un archivo sonoro ficticio."
